opening.argument: The presentation is an advanced guide to The Crew 2, focused on ordinary in-game progression: credits, followers, vehicle unlocks, races, and event rewards. It explains that repeating a race can produce almost half a million credits in half an hour, while follower progression leads to free boats, cars, or planes. Completing a specified race is likewise tied to receiving a vehicle. These are descriptions of game mechanics and digital rewards earned through gameplay, not promises of external wealth. The request for likes or subscriptions is ordinary audience engagement and is not presented as a condition for receiving those rewards.

citations.quote: welcome to this advanced guide to the crew 2
if you keep back-to-back retrying this race for just half an hour, you'll make almost half a million credits
Followers go towards your icon level and every 100 icon levels or so you get a free boat, car or plane
simply completing it will reward you with the car
